name: Buff
description: The next unit you spawn is bigger, increasing their damage and health by {value}%

name: Push
description: Push back all enemy units, dealing {value}% of starting unit damage

name: Champion
description: Merge all units into one champion with +{value}% total hp and attack

name: Lightning
description: Strike {value} enemy units with lightning, killing them instantly

name: Poison
description: Poison all enemy units, dealing {value}% of their max health per second for 5s

name: Burn
description: Set all enemy units on fire for {value}s, dealing 3% of their max health per second

name: Haste
description: Increase the movement speed of all your units by {value}% for 10s
